jobs.title: Drift Wood #17 · the photo
jobs.prompt: a four-panel comic strip laid out as a two-by-two grid on a half page, thin black panel borders (4 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, drawn the same in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 18, gaunt boy drawn a head too tall, oversized thrift-store wool overcoat to the knee worn indoors, faded black tee, dark jeans, sneakers, a bristol pad clutched flat to his chest, chin up. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: The yearbook photo for the superlative. Wood has thoughts about composition. Panel 1: a teenage boy in an overcoat posed against school lockers directing a yearbook photographer to shoot from a lower angle (in this panel: WOOD). Wood says "Lower. From below. Eisenstein. The subject should loom.". Panel 2: close-up of a patient student photographer with a camera. Photog says "It's a yearbook. Everyone looms the same amount.". Panel 3: a teenage boy adjusting his overcoat collar in front of a trophy case full of trophies, school hallway (in this panel: WOOD). Wood says "Then let the trophies loom. I'll provide contrast.". Panel 4: a yearbook photograph of a gaunt teenage boy in an overcoat shot from slightly below against lockers, looking like he already regrets the pose, typeset caption beneath (in this panel: WOOD). caption box: "MOST LIKELY TO WIN A PULITZER — Arthur Finch". Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR" beside a tiny stylized gull, two strokes. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Match the attached references: @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17; @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23.
